summary: Copel (Energy Company of Parana) filed a 6-K announcing it entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to sell its 23.03% equity interest in Dona Francisca Energética S.A., the shareholder of the consortium running the Dona Francisca Hydroelectric Plant, to Gerdau S.A. The deal is based on an enterprise value of R$150 million (implied proceeds for the stake not directly stated), with full payment in cash at closing. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The divestiture aligns with Copel's portfolio optimization and simplification strategy. Conditions include corporate and regulatory approvals. Watch for antitrust clearance and closing timeline; risk-arb angle hinges on regulatory delays.
